name: Kurumi Masato
source:
Masato is Haruka's older brother. Soft-mannered, he's popular with anybody regardless of age or gender. He's kinder and sweeter to his younger sister more than anybody else, showering her with love. He's carrying a huge trauma from his past, but doesn't want to talk about it in detail.

[Translation of his [URL=http://rejetweb.jp/moshikami/character/masato.html]official website profile[/URL].]
